events.title: Salesforce Q2 FY27 results (macro read)
events.why: Enterprise software/AI-agent demand signal for GOOGL/AMZN cloud and the broader SaaS tape (NET, HOOD multiples).

events.title: Australia CPI July: 3.5% y/y (vs 3.2% consensus, 3.8% prior); trimmed mean 3.6%; +1.0% m/m original, +0.6% s.a.
events.why: Upside surprise on fuel and travel; markets now price RBA hike risk into the 28-29 Sep meeting, supporting AUD and weighing on the AUD-translated US book.

events.title: US Q2 GDP second estimate + July Personal Income & Outlays (PCE inflation)
events.why: Core PCE is the Fed's preferred gauge and lands two days before Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote; sets the rate backdrop for long-duration tech.

events.title: US Treasury $70B 5-year note auction (plus $28B 2-year FRN)
events.why: Belly-of-the-curve demand check hours before NVDA prints and the same morning as GDP/PCE; a tail would lift yields into Warsh's Friday keynote. Amounts per TreasuryDirect; 13:00 ET is the standard note auction close.

events.title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 results and call
events.why: Largest holding and the AI-capex bellwether; data-center guide and Rubin ramp commentary move NVDA, AVGO, MRVL, TSM, MU, ALAB and SKHY together.

events.title: Kansas City Fed Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium opens; theme 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy'
events.why: Payments/stablecoin-focused theme is directly relevant to FIGR, HOOD, AXOS and Stripe; sets global rate expectations into the Sep 15-16 FOMC.

events.title: ABS Private New Capital Expenditure, June quarter 2026 (actual and expected capex)
events.why: Feeds the Sep 2 GDP print and the RBA's read on business investment ahead of the Sep 28-29 meeting.

events.title: US Treasury $44B 7-year note auction
events.why: Completes the 2/5/7-year cycle before Jackson Hole; weak coverage would pressure long-duration tech multiples. Amount per TreasuryDirect; 13:00 ET is the standard note auction close.

events.time: after US close (13:45 PT / 16:45 ET call)
events.title: Marvell Q2 FY2027 results
events.why: Custom-silicon and optics read-through for the AI networking basket (AVGO, ALAB) one day after NVDA; Marvell also confirmed an Investor Day on Oct 6, 2026 in New York (outside window).

events.title: Samsung Galaxy Event August 2026: Galaxy S26 FE expected (Exynos 2500, ~$799)
events.why: Minor: mid-range handset refresh; only relevance is memory content and pricing signal for MU/SKHY into a tight DRAM market.

events.time: TBC (HK, board meeting 28 Aug; typically after HK close)
events.title: BYD (1211.HK) 2026 interim results: board meeting confirmed for 28 Aug 2026 (six months to 30 Jun)
events.why: Date now confirmed via BYD's HKEX board-meeting notice (reported by TipRanks/Globe and Mail); release time still not published. Margin vs record exports is the key read for CATL (3750) and the China EV complex.

events.title: Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman fireside chat (virtual)
events.why: Bank supervision and capital comments matter for AXOS, HOOD, FIGR, RKT and LDI.

events.title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh keynote at Jackson Hole (livestream youtube.com/KansasCityFed)
events.why: The single biggest rates catalyst of the fortnight; any signal on September easing or balance-sheet policy reprices growth equities and the USD.

events.title: BLS preliminary benchmark revision to payrolls (Mar 2026)
events.why: Last year's revision was -911K; a large negative print again would strengthen the case for cuts and weaken the labour backdrop for credit names.

events.title: University of Michigan consumer sentiment, final August
events.why: Inflation-expectations component feeds the Fed narrative the same morning as the Warsh keynote.

events.title: China NBS manufacturing and non-manufacturing PMI (August)
events.why: Official activity gauge for BABA, SE, CATL/BYD demand and for AUD via commodities; date per TradingEconomics (NBS calendar page not reachable).

events.title: RatingDog (ex-Caixin) China manufacturing PMI (August)
events.why: Private-sector cross-check on the NBS print for BABA/SE/CATL exposure.

events.title: Credo Technology Q1 FY2027 results (quarter ended Aug 1)
events.why: Closest public comp to Astera Labs and Marvell's connectivity lines; hyperscaler AEC/optical demand and customer concentration read.

events.title: Dell Technologies Q2 FY27 results (macro read)
events.why: AI-server backlog and shipment numbers are a direct demand check on NVDA/AVGO/MRVL/MU/SKHY.

events.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (August)
events.why: New orders and prices-paid components are the cleanest read on the industrial/AI-infrastructure build (GEV, BE, TER, ENR); time per TradingEconomics.

events.title: JOLTS job openings (July)
events.why: First labour print of the week that ends with payrolls; openings trend informs Fed cut odds.

events.title: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 results and call
events.why: Custom AI accelerator (XPU) and networking guide is the key watchlist catalyst and a read-across to MRVL, ALAB and NVDA.

events.title: Fed Beige Book
events.why: Last scheduled Fed communication before the pre-FOMC blackout ahead of the 15-16 Sep meeting; regional colour on AI data-centre capex and consumer credit.

events.time: after US close (15:30 CT / 16:30 ET call)
events.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Q3 FY2026 results (quarter ended Jul 31)
events.why: AI-server backlog, Blackwell shipments and server margins alongside Dell (Sep 1) and Broadcom (same night); demand read for NVDA, TSM, MU.

events.title: Australian National Accounts: GDP June quarter 2026
events.why: Growth print that shapes the RBA's 28-29 Sep decision and AUD.

events.title: ADP private payrolls (August)
events.why: Preview of Friday's jobs report; time per TradingEconomics.

events.time: all day CST (Sep 2-4; forums from Aug 31)
events.title: SEMICON Taiwan 2026, Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center (Sep 2-4)
events.why: Advanced packaging (CoWoS/panel-level), HBM and 2nm supply-chain commentary from TSMC ecosystem vendors; read-across for TSM, MU, SKHY, AVGO and NVDA capacity constraints.

events.title: RatingDog China services PMI (August)
events.why: Consumer-services momentum check for BABA and SE.

events.title: Ciena fiscal Q3 2026 results (guide $1.625B +/- $50M)
events.why: Optical/data-centre interconnect bellwether for hyperscaler capex; cross-read for MRVL, AVGO, ALAB.

events.title: ISM Services PMI (August); also Q2 productivity (revised) and July trade balance at 08:30 ET
events.why: Services activity and prices set the inflation tone into CPI on Sep 11; time per TradingEconomics.

events.title: Employment Situation (August payrolls, unemployment rate)
events.why: Final jobs print before the Sep 15-16 FOMC; decides whether the market prices a cut and drives the USD/AUD cross.

events.title: US Labor Day: NYSE/Nasdaq closed
events.why: No US cash session; ASX trades normally, so AU-listed exposure moves without a US lead.

events.title: China trade balance, exports and imports (August)
events.why: Export strength and chip/commodity import data inform CATL/BYD, TSM and AUD; date per TradingEconomics.

events.title: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference begins (Sep 8-10); MercadoLibre presents Sep 8 (Cloudflare Sep 9, 10:10 PT, listed separately)
events.why: Major sell-side tech conference where holdings/watchlist names give intra-quarter updates; MELI fintech/credit commentary and NET AI-traffic commentary are the ones to listen for.

events.title: Apple 'Surprise and Shine' event: iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max and foldable iPhone Ultra expected (invite sent Aug 26)
events.why: Loved company and first launch under CEO John Ternus; TSM 2nm A20 volumes, memory content and iPhone Ultra pricing set the non-AI demand backdrop for TSM and MU.

events.title: US Treasury 10-year note auction (3-year on Sep 8, 30-year on Sep 10; amounts announced Sep 3)
events.why: Long-end demand check the same day as the expected Apple event and NET's Communacopia slot, two days before CPI; time per TradingEconomics (17:00 GMT).

events.title: Cloudflare fireside chat at Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference (San Francisco)
events.why: Intra-quarter update on AI-crawler/agent traffic, Workers AI and large-enterprise deal momentum; first management commentary since the Aug 6 Q2 print that sent NET up 17%. Slot carried forward from the prior calendar note (Sep 9, 10:10 PT); Cloudflare's IR events page did not render a listing on this pass, so confirm the webcast link on the day.

events.title: Adobe Q3 FY2026 results (macro read; date per Investing.com, not yet confirmed by Adobe)
events.why: Read on whether AI is monetising or cannibalising seat-based software after the Salesforce beat; sets the SaaS tape for NET and HOOD multiples the day before CPI.

events.title: US PPI August and weekly jobless claims (30-year bond auction 13:00 ET); CPI follows Sep 11, outside this window
events.why: Last inflation input before CPI on Sep 11 and the Sep 15-16 FOMC; PPI components feed the Fed's PCE estimate. Date/time per TradingEconomics (bls.gov schedule not reachable).

events.time: TBC (expected after US close; date not yet confirmed by Oracle)
events.title: Oracle Q1 FY2027 results (macro read; Sep 10 per Seeking Alpha preview, Oracle has not announced the date)
events.why: Oracle's RPO ($638B, +363%) is the backlog leg of the capex-vs-backlog bellwether; OCI growth, capex and OpenAI-contract commentary read across to NVDA, AVGO, MRVL and the neocloud credit picture.

events.title: US CPI August (headline and core)
events.why: Last inflation print before the Sep 15-16 FOMC; July CPI was 3.4% y/y and July PCE 3.7%, so a hot number would price out a September cut. Date/time per TradingEconomics (bls.gov schedule returned 403 on this pass).

events.title: University of Michigan consumer sentiment, preliminary September
events.why: Inflation-expectations read the same morning as CPI; date follows the usual second-Friday pattern (UMich site so far lists only the Aug 28 final), and the Fed is in pre-FOMC blackout so no speakers that day.
